package.name: lkh_mtsp_solver
package.description: LKH-3 based (A)CVRP/MTSP solver, invoked as a standalone rclcpp node (mtsp_node) exposing the /solve_tsp_<id> and /solve_acvrp_<id> services used by exploration_manager for grid/frontier task allocation. This is the solver actually used at runtime (the sibling lkh_tsp_solver package in the original ROS1 repo builds a plain-TSP tsp_node that is never wired into any launch file - its add_executable is commented out in its own CMakeLists.txt - so it was not ported).
